integrity: The proof contains a direct polar-width fiber integral and symbolic polynomial identities. The standalone checker carries out independent convex-hull comparisons and finite symbolic tests. No independent scientific assessment has been performed.
limitations: The exact factorization concerns homothetic frusta over arbitrary full-dimensional convex bases. In dimension three, the sharp lower bound follows from Eggleston's previously established planar inequality. No general three-dimensional or higher-dimensional Makai conjecture is asserted. The prism endpoint is understood after affine normalization. Historical coverage by unindexed sources is not excluded.
title: A universal Makai-volume law for homothetic frusta and a sharp three-dimensional bound
